react_result.final_narrative_text: The seven-differential metabolite set converges unambiguously on arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant perturbed pathway, with cross-paradigm agreement across ORA, m/z-direct, and KEGG-specific enrichment. RaMP multi-database ORA placed the top SMPDB hits (rank 0–14) in a cluster of NSAID/pharmacological action pathways — each containing the same five lipid inputs (15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2, 5-HETE, arachidonic acid, 11,12,15-THETA, leukotriene A4) with an extraordinary fold-enrichment of 857.8 and FDR of 8.38e-15. The SMPDB Leukotriene C4 Synthesis Deficiency pathway (SMP00353) is the anchor of this cluster. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis ranked 'arachidonic acid metabolism' (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as the top hit (p=0.00126) with 10 matched metabolites, followed by 'prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' (p=0.0135) and 'leukotriene metabolism' (p=0.0216). MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00590 (arachidonic acid metabolism) as the sole significant pathway (p=2.49e-06), matching four of the input metabolites. CDP maps to N-glycan biosynthesis, pyrimidine metabolism, and CoA biosynthesis via a separate branch unrelated to the lipid axis. The biological story is a coordinated perturbation of the arachidonic acid cascade: upstream substrate accumulation (arachidonic acid, 11,12,15-THETA) co-occurs with elevated products of both the cyclooxygenase arm (15-deoxy-PGJ2, a cyclopentenone prostaglandin) and the lipoxygenase arm (5-HETE via 5-LOX, leukotriene A4 via LTA4 hydrolase). This pattern is consistent with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) disruption of the prostaglandin branch paired with upstream substrate shunting toward the leukotriene branch — the canonical therapeutic mechanism of NSAID action observed at the metabolome level.

FELLA R subprocess errored at runtime (currently 'argument is of length zero' on every sub6b-v3 task — W9 D4 stretch target); skip the network/diffusion paradigm and rely on ORA + mummichog

pathway_members.sqlite only indexes HUMAN1 + RECON2; for namespace 'KEGG', inspect the `metabolites_hit` list inside an EnrichmentResult (e.g. from run_ramp_enrichment) — it carries the method-specific compound roster
double-check the pathway slug; HUMAN1 slugs are snake_case like 'alanine_aspartate_and_glutamate_metabolism'

The cross-paradigm winner is Arachidonic acid metabolism, evidenced by its presence in all three enrichment paradigms with high statistical significance.

RaMP multi-database ORA placed the top SMPDB hits (rank 0–14) in a cluster of NSAID/pharmacological action pathways — each containing the same five lipid inputs (15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2, 5-HETE, arachidonic acid, 11,12,15-THETA, leukotriene A4) with an extraordinary fold-enrichment of 857.8 and FDR of 8.38e-15. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis ranked 'arachidonic acid metabolism' (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as the top hit (p=0.00126) with 10 matched metabolites, followed by 'prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' (p=0.0135) and 'leukotriene metabolism' (p=0.0216). MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00590 (arachidonic acid metabolism) as the sole significant pathway (p=2.49e-06), matching four of the input metabolites. CDP maps to N-glycan biosynthesis, pyrimidine metabolism, and CoA biosynthesis via a separate branch unrelated to the lipid axis. The biological story is a coordinated perturbation of the arachidonic acid cascade: upstream substrate accumulation (arachidonic acid, 11,12,15-THETA) co-occurs with elevated products of both the cyclooxygenase arm (15-deoxy-PGJ2, a cyclopentenone prostaglandin) and the lipoxygenase arm (5-HETE via 5-LOX, leukotriene A4 via LTA4 hydrolase). final_react_result.final_narrative_text: The seven-differential metabolite set converges unambiguously on arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant perturbed pathway, with cross-paradigm agreement across ORA, m/z-direct, and KEGG-specific enrichment. RaMP multi-database ORA placed the top SMPDB hits (rank 0–14) in a cluster of NSAID/pharmacological action pathways — each containing the same five lipid inputs (15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2, 5-HETE, arachidonic acid, 11,12,15-THETA, leukotriene A4) with an extraordinary fold-enrichment of 857.8 and FDR of 8.38e-15. The SMPDB Leukotriene C4 Synthesis Deficiency pathway (SMP00353) is the anchor of this cluster. Mummichog m/z-direct analysis ranked 'arachidonic acid metabolism' (MUMM:arachidonic_acid_metabolism) as the top hit (p=0.00126) with 10 matched metabolites, followed by 'prostaglandin formation from arachidonate' (p=0.0135) and 'leukotriene metabolism' (p=0.0216). MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA returned KEGG:hsa00590 (arachidonic acid metabolism) as the sole significant pathway (p=2.49e-06), matching four of the input metabolites. CDP maps to N-glycan biosynthesis, pyrimidine metabolism, and CoA biosynthesis via a separate branch unrelated to the lipid axis. The biological story is a coordinated perturbation of the arachidonic acid cascade: upstream substrate accumulation (arachidonic acid, 11,12,15-THETA) co-occurs with elevated products of both the cyclooxygenase arm (15-deoxy-PGJ2, a cyclopentenone prostaglandin) and the lipoxygenase arm (5-HETE via 5-LOX, leukotriene A4 via LTA4 hydrolase). This pattern is consistent with non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) disruption of the prostaglandin branch paired with upstream substrate shunting toward the leukotriene branch — the canonical therapeutic mechanism of NSAID action observed at the metabolome level.
